title: Multi-node cross-shard transactions
statement: The system shall commit or abort atomically all writes of a transaction spanning multiple nodes, edges and shards.
rationale: Graph mutations routinely touch several entities and both ends of each edge.

acceptance_criteria.text: A transaction writing nodes and edges on 3 different shards, with a coordinator crash injected at each commit phase, leaves either all or none of the writes visible after recovery (100 trials).
